items.item_text: Bachelors Degree and/or equivalent combination of education and experience
2+ years of experience coordinating an educational program(s) in an academic medical center

The Program Coordinator plays a key role in supporting the successful delivery of educational programs and initiatives. Partnering closely with faculty and program leadership, the incumbent helps manage program operations, finances, and learner support services to create an engaging and effective educational experience.
Coordinate and support the day‑to‑day operations of educational programs and initiatives.
Assist with program planning, implementation, promotion, and evaluation to ensure achievement of educational goals.
Support learners through curriculum coordination, scheduling, assessments, evaluations, and educational activities.
Monitor program operations to ensure compliance with institutional and accreditation requirements.
Collaborate with faculty, staff, and stakeholders to enhance program quality and participant experience.
Manage administrative, operational, and financial activities related to the program.
This role offers an opportunity to contribute to impactful educational programs while working in a collaborative, mission‑driven environment dedicated to learner success.
High degree of initiative and independent judgement
Comprehensive understanding of UCLA policy and procedures

Presents and expresses ideas and information clearly and concisely in a manner appropriate to the audience, whether oral or written. Actively listens to what others are saying to achieve understanding. Shares information with others and facilitates the open exchange of ideas and information.
Manages confidential information discreetly and responsibly

Open to change and new information; adapts behavior and work processes in response to new information, changing conditions, or unexpected obstacles. Acclimates quickly to new situations warranting attention and resolution.

Excellent organizational and analytical skills; demonstrated attention to detail. Ability to complete work and meet established deadlines in an accurate and timely manner, and to prioritize short and competing deadlines.
Demonstrated interpersonal skills and ability to interact collegially with faculty, staff, learners and outside contacts to carry out the mission of the educational program(s) or initiative(s)
Proficient with Microsoft Office programs and web based applications.
Demonstrated commitment to knowledge development/professional development
Demonstrated ability to communicate medical, policy and administrative information
